==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:curraunt<ety:bor<fro:corant<alt:curant>>>}}
From {{inh|en|enm|curraunt}}, borrowed from {{der|en|fro|corant|curant}} ({{cog|fr|courant}}), present participle of {{m|fro|courre|t=to run}}, from {{der|en|la|currō|currere|t=to run}} (present participle {{m|la|currens}}). {{doublet|en|courant}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|kŭr′ənt|kûr′ənt|a2=hurry-furry}}
* {{IPA|en|a=RP|/ˈkʌɹənt/}}
** {{audio|en|en-uk-currant.ogg|a=UK}} <!-- same as homophone, unlikely to be different -->
* {{IPA|en|a=Northern England,Midlands|/ˈkʊɹənt/}}
* {{IPA|en|a=AuE,NZ|/ˈkɐɹənt/}}
* {{a|en|GA|Canada}}
** {{IPA|en|a=non-hurry-furry|/ˈkʌɹɪnt/|/ˈkʌɹənt/}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-ne-current.ogg|a=US}}
** {{IPA|en|a=hurry-furry|/ˈkɜɹɪnt/|/ˈkɜɹənt/}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-current.ogg|a=US,hurry-furry}}
* {{rhymes|en|ʌɹənt|ɜː(ɹ)ənt|s=2}}
* {{hmp|en|currant}}
* {{hmp|en|courant<aa:with both the <<hurry-furry>> and <<cure-fir>>>}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The [[generally]] [[unidirectional]] [[movement]] of a [[gas]] or [[fluid]].
# The part of a [[fluid]] that moves continuously in a certain direction, especially {{lb|en|oceanography}} {{ellipsis of|en|ocean current|nocap=a}}.
#: {{syn|en|flow|stream}}
# {{lb|en|electricity}} {{ellipsis of|en|electric current}}.
## {{lb|en|by extension|South Asia}} [[electricity]], [[power]] in general.
# A [[tendency]] or a [[course]] of [[event]]s.
#: {{syn|en|flow|stream|tendency}}

====Usage notes====
* Not to be confused with ''[[currant]]''.

The use of ACs will increase not only in homes but also in commercial establishments and '''current''' consumption will increase.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240717023819/https://www.thehansindia.com/telangana/telangana-even-the-tsspdcl-is-facing-heavy-losses-due-to-covid-19-690651|archivedate=17 July 2024}}
